steps.instruction: Keep your own Final Fantasy Tactics Advance USA GBA ROM (AFXE), expected SHA-1 4ac05441f4de70a4ec3dd932116346c61b8783d9. steps.instruction: Select FFTARecomp.exe with its complete creating package directory as working directory and no extra arguments for the normal in-process launch screen. Retain only the supported literal arguments your working setup actually requires, including existing --save/--save-path and --state-dir choices. steps.title: Review the attachment and choose Play separately
steps.instruction: Review and consent to this exact native executable, working directory and literal arguments, then choose Play separately. Upstream and you own preparation, replacement and recovery of external files. Removing registration preserves every external file. steps.title: Preserve saves and all effective external roots
steps.instruction: The inspected game.toml uses saves/ffta_us.sav relative to its own directory for the 64KiB battery save. Existing --save or --save-path overrides can point elsewhere. Save-state slots normally live beside the actual selected ROM with .stateN names; --state-dir moves those basenames to the chosen directory. Do not assume all states live beside the player or in states/. Preserve your ROM directory and its state/sidecar files, actual custom save/state directories, the complete creating runtime, saves/, rom.cfg, bios.cfg, skip_launcher_on_boot, config.ini, keybinds.ini, game.toml, config overlays, mods, screenshots, logs, backups and temporary files.
